item.title: A new Hytale update makes navigating the map much easier, buffs necromancy, and promises your name won't be stolen
item.description: The new pre-release Hytale update includes map markers, fresh cosmetics, combat balance changes, more block textures, and quality of life.

item.title: As complaints mount, Fortnite has formed a new "strike team" of devs to tackle the battle royale's biggest problems
item.description: Fortnite's design director, who's been through all this before with Call of Duty Warzone, announces a change in approach from Epic.

item.title: New Deadlock hero Graves isn't quite the summoner class I was hoping for, but she might still be my new favorite
item.description: Valve’s new Deadlock hero Graves is out now, with abilities that let her summon skulls and zombies, but she plays more like Dota’s Undying.

item.title: Black Ops 7 Season 2 is bringing some wild loadout additions, and I haven't been this scared of a scorestreak in years
item.description: The new weapons arriving in Black Ops 7 Season 2 range from your typical assault rifles, to a sticky grenade launcher, to a BO4 favorite.

item.title: Starfield 2.0 is hopefully just around the corner, and the sci-fi RPG is at its lowest price just in time
item.description: With a potential overhaul coming with Starfield 2.0, you don’t want to miss out on the action, so make sure to grab it while it's cheaper than ever.

item.title: A new Escape From Tarkov collab with the 'rival' that stole its Steam launch thunder adds one of Arc Raiders' best bits
item.description: In a strange twist of fate, an Escape From Tarkov collaboration with namesake Duckov gives it an answer to Arc Raiders’ beloved ducks.

item.title: After Peak's success, this atmospheric new mountain-climbing indie game just scaled to 100,000 players in a single day
item.description: New mountain-climbing indie game Cairn celebrates its launch success, offering a more atmospheric, personal twist on the format after Peak.

item.title: After joking about buying Amazon MMO New World, Rust boss says to "keep hope" as he signs NDA with an "unnamed company"
item.description: Word of a mystery NDA from Alistair McFarlane, head of Rust developer Facepunch Studios, has New World players dreaming of a miracle savior.

item.title: A major Soulframe combat upgrade kicks off a year of "big swings" as the RPG aims to be more than 'fantasy Warframe'
item.description: Soulframe Devstream 12 reveals a dramatic Virtues rework, improvements to combat, a new mission type, and more weapons for the fantasy RPG.

item.title: Ubisoft promises "important changes" to Rainbow Six Siege X including Secure Boot as holiday cyberattack fallout lingers
item.description: Ubisoft outlines improvements to account security, anti-cheat, and counters to toxicity as the Rainbow Six Siege X marketplace remains shut.
